acceptanceCriteria: Baseline and candidate use the same machine, toolchain, build mode, and scenario; every claimed percentile has at least 100 valid warm samples.
The report contains raw samples, environment identity, execution and reuse counts, diagnostic availability, and invalidation reasons; unavailable metrics are stated as unavailable rather than zero.
No speed-up is claimed unless target-path improvement exceeds the reviewed noise range; non-target critical scenarios have no over-budget regression.
The optimization preserves authorization, evidence freshness, and verification reuse semantics, including zero verification subprocesses on unmet deterministic prerequisites.
Runtime diagnostics do not contribute to business-evidence identity.
authority: human:xinglun standing authorization for in-scope implementation and verification; release remains separately authorized and last.
goal: Produce same-machine baseline and candidate evidence with at least 100 valid warm samples for a selected target; adopt only a bounded optimization whose improvement exceeds measured noise, otherwise retain the diagnosis and report no speed-up.
intent: Use current paired Runtime measurements to identify and remove one measured hot-path cost without relaxing authorization, evidence freshness, or verification semantics.
outOfScope: Release publication; object-repository modifications; authorization or evidence-policy relaxation; Outcome host adapters; full lifecycle architecture refactors; performance claims without paired evidence.
scope: tests/performance/**; crates/cockpit-cli/tests/performance.rs; selected Runtime hot-path implementation discovered by measurement; docs/reference/performance-diagnosis.md; docs/work-items/WI-941-runtime-performance-hotpath*.md; docs/reference/reference-parity*.md
